update_message:
What's New in 2.1.3:

🎵 Now Playing Improvements
• Added 3-dot menu with track options (Add to Playlist, Go to Album/Artist, Share, Track Info)
• Track info dialog shows sample rate, bit depth, duration

📱 Mini Player Fixed
• Mini player now shows whenever music is playing
• Fixed visibility issues across all screens

🔤 A-Z Quick Navigation
• New alphabet rail on songs list for fast scrolling
• Haptic feedback and smooth animations
• Drag or tap to jump to any letter

⚡ Performance Improvements
• Faster list scrolling with increased cache
• Removed animation delays for instant item display
• Incremental library scanning (only rescans changed folders)

📂 Add Music Button Fixed
• FAB now properly positioned in bottom-right corner
• Clean bottom sheet with all import options

🔀 Sorting Options
• Sort Songs by Title, Artist, Album, Year, Duration
• Sort Albums by Name, Artist, Year, Tracks
• Sort Artists by Name, Tracks
• Ascending/descending toggle
